answer: Each identity sets one sensor in a hollow on a ledge, locking 70 credits. A beacon summons a sample; the sensor answers in 10 minutes with a key-signed heartbeat, fresh reading, new serial. Auditors replay it on the delta log; late or reused readings burn the bond. First 40, k-th 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500, lock 70,000, vs 40,000 pool. One key serving three hollow sites on one ledge flags rented-sensor rings; honest agents pay 40 once.
